artifact: PERSIST estimator validation — instrument proven before use
why: feedback: prove the instrument first. Run on SYNTHETIC data with known truth, before the estimator touches either real surface. Zero contact with eval2024 or train_flat4y.

T1_recovers_planted_effect.design: beta=0.5 in all 9 systems, confounder z drives both persistence and outcome

T2_true_null.verdict: no detectable bias — the estimator does not manufacture an effect

T3_heterogeneity_and_shrinkage.verdict: tau recovered; shrinkage strictly reduces dispersion as required

T4_confounding_control.design: true effect 0, confounder z drives BOTH persistence and outcome (conf=1.5)
T4_confounding_control.verdict: adjustment removes a +14.8pp confounded signal to ~0

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: design() standardised zero-variance controls to a column of zeros, making the observed-information matrix singular; fit_system() then returned None and the system was SILENTLY DROPPED from the pooled estimate.
defects_found_and_fixed.impact: on real data a small system (visibility, n_AA=9) could vanish without trace
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: zero-variance columns are dropped outright; degenerate quantile splits skipped

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: np.linalg.inv raised on near-singular designs, dropping the system
defects_found_and_fixed.fix: np.linalg.pinv — a near-singular design degrades to a WIDE SE, which shrinkage then handles, rather than to a missing system

calibration_note: per-replicate sd of the standardised effect is ~0.61 pp at n=22,500 synthetic rows. Scaled to cohort B (172,304 rows) that predicts ~0.22 pp, coherent with the independently-derived MDE80 of 0.337 pp at p0=0.05 in PERSIST_POWER_AT_BAR.json.
what_this_does_not_prove: Synthetic data cannot validate the SUBSTANTIVE assumptions — that the control set blocks the real confounding paths, or that the state ladder captures the intended construct. It proves the estimator computes what it claims to compute.
